// Positive control (#5170, the original #4686 shape): a gate verb entry (dispatched by the router fixture
// verb-no-gate-exit-router.cts.txt) with one branch that emits through the exit seam and an early
// `output({ error }); return;` branch that does not — that path owns its exit (or leaves it to output()).
import { output } from './io.cjs';
import { declareGateExit } from './gate-exit.cjs';
import { gateVerdict } from './gate-verdict.cjs';

function emitVerbVerdict(verdict: ReturnType<typeof gateVerdict>, raw: boolean): void {
  output(verdict.payload, raw);
  declareGateExit(verdict, 'status');
}

export function cmdFixtureVerb(file: string, raw: boolean): void {
  if (!file) {
    output({ error: 'file required' }, raw);
    return;
  }
  emitVerbVerdict(gateVerdict('pass', false, { valid: true }), raw);
}
